Job Title: Informatica BDM Developer 
 Location: NYC, NY 
 Duration: Contract/ Fulltime 
 
 Job Description: 
 
 Big Data Technologies 
 Informatica Stack ( Must Have) Informatica Power Center, Power Exchange, Cloud, MDM , IDQ, Data Masking Informatica Big Data Edition ( Mandatory) Optional Informatica Stack IIR, PIM Vibe, BRDM, Real Time edition DWBI Stack MPP's ( atleast one): Teradata, Netezza, Redshift RDBMS: Any Additional Skils Visualization using Spotfire / Tableau / Qlikview Big Data ( Mandtory ) Project experience with ETL tools such as Informatica / Talend on Big Data ecosystem. Good working knowledge of the ecosystem works in Big Data. Ability to develop custom components in Informatica in Informatica BIg Data Edition. 
 Experience Project ( 3 Years Min) 
 Project Must have worked on atleast 1-3 projects with Informatica BDM and the Project should have gone Live to Production Preferable that the candidate has worked on large scale DW-BI programs Skills Build distributed, scalable, and reliable Informatica BDM workflows that ingest and process data at scale and in real-time. Collaborate with other teams to design and develop and deploy data tools that support both operations and product use cases. Own product features from the development phase through to production deployment. Troubleshoot data issues, deep dive into root cause analysis, recommend, test and implement solutions Develop and document technical requirements and solutions Participate in design and code reviews Troubleshoot issues making recommendations and delivering on those recommendations Other Skills Self starter, with solution thinking be able to debate pros & cons and arrive and solutions Good articulations skills to present solution 
 Prior Experience Before DW BI ( 5years min) 
 * ETL / DWBI Development Projects * PL/SQL programming * Data Modeling 


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
